description: The file is a PHP script that handles AJAX requests for troubleshooting logs (system, event, firewall). It verifies user login, processes POST parameters to determine log timeframe and mode, executes system commands to retrieve logs, filters logs by time range, outputs logs in JSON format, and writes filtered logs to temporary files.

methods.name: str2time
methods.description: Converts a date/time string into a structured array with formatted_time, firewall_time, and a UNIX timestamp.
